schema_note: Feature inventory for PACT. Each feature lists its implementation locations, a status from the shared vocabulary, and the evidence (tests or live checks) that establishes the status. Status values: implemented_verified, implemented_partially_verified, partially_implemented, planned, deprecated, unknown.

status_vocabulary.implemented_verified: Implemented and exercised by an automated test and/or a recorded live check.
status_vocabulary.implemented_partially_verified: Implemented; some path is not covered by an automated test or a live check.
status_vocabulary.partially_implemented: Works for some inputs but is incomplete.

features.name: Guest sessions
features.description: Server-provisioned, isolated buyer workspaces so the product is usable with no account.

features.name: Job creation
features.description: Post a job with a brief, acceptance criteria, and a hard budget ceiling.
evidence: live: local run created a job

features.name: Offers and negotiation
features.description: Multi-round bargaining between buyer and seller agents with an in-code budget guardrail.

features.name: Payment authorization (hold)
features.description: PayPal intent=AUTHORIZE order, buyer approval, then authorize; hold recorded only for a holdable status.

features.name: Capture and settlement
features.description: Capture the authorization on a passing verification; settled only when capture status is COMPLETED.

features.name: Void (return on failed verification)
features.description: Void the hold on a failed verification and confirm the void by re-reading the authorization.
evidence: live: local run ended voided with a confirmed void

features.name: Refund
features.description: Reverse a captured payment in full or in part, capped at the captured amount and idempotent per operation.

features.name: Duplicate capture/refund prevention
features.description: In-flight claim persisted before the provider call; settlement guard; per-operation idempotency keys.

features.name: Reconciliation of ambiguous outcomes
features.description: Resolve an unresolved job by reading PayPal directly; never a blind retry.

features.name: AI negotiation and verification
features.description: Seller, buyer-counter, and verifier roles over any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; a deterministic fallback when no key is set.

features.name: Hash-chained audit ledger
features.description: Append-only per-job ledger with SHA-256 hash chaining; tamper-evident and verified live.

features.name: Durable PostgreSQL ledger
features.description: JSONB job documents plus reputation, webhook, and ticket tables; instance-safe settlement claim.

features.name: Webhook verification and exactly-once processing
features.description: Verify a PayPal webhook signature through PayPal's own endpoint and apply each event at most once.

features.name: Live SSE ledger stream
features.description: Server-sent events of the job's ledger, authenticated by a single-use ticket or a bearer header.

features.name: Bearer authentication and roles
features.description: HS256 bearer tokens with buyer/seller/admin roles; fail closed without a secret.

features.name: Object-level authorization
features.description: Every job access checks party membership; a non-owner gets 404, not 403.

features.name: CSRF protection for guest sessions
features.description: Cookie-authenticated mutating requests must echo the session CSRF token.

features.name: Sandbox-only guard and fail-closed validation
features.description: Refuse a live PayPal host; refuse to start in production without a secret, a database, or with a mock settlement.

features.name: Bounded request bodies and run concurrency
features.description: 64 KiB request cap on received bytes; a bounded semaphore for concurrent runs; run deadline.

features.name: Reputation and market selection
features.description: A smoothed verified-delivery score per seller, fed back into seller selection.

features.name: Guest-first frontend
features.description: React/Vite/Tailwind UI: composer, negotiation, verification, ledger, payment panel, reputation.

features.name: Customer accounts and email outbox
features.description: Opt-in self-service accounts (Argon2id, rotating refresh tokens) and a crash-safe transactional email outbox.
features.note: The end-to-end email delivery path needs a real provider and verified sending domain; it is not exercised live.

features.name: Pooled-endpoint settlement routing
features.description: Prove the settlement session lock is not routed through a transaction-mode pooler.
features.note: These tests run only when PGBOUNCER_URL is set (the CI job provides it); a bare local run skips 5 tests.

not_implemented.name: Real-money deployment path with operational controls
Additional settlement rails behind the escrow interface
